questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original Cosmology/Matrix/surviving World manuscripts precede later interpretation; owner update02 resolves the earlier source-preference ambiguity. Planes review is bounded, not a completed ontology. The saved website is preserved source, not a metric map.
options: Retain originals, exact owner corrections and separately scoped accepted mechanics; leave unproved realm identities open.
Promote later terminology or map proximity into objective realm equivalence.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend the first option. No Shadowfell=Veiled Expanse, Void=entity, natural-origin or afterlife inference. Mechanical generated-space IDs can be new scoped authorship without naming a canonical plane.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Native access, Action/120ft/V,S,F/21RP and original duration fields are preserved. Dimensional Anchor, Planar Barrier, Banishment and Faction Portal have different exact transport rules.
options: Classify each spell operation explicitly: creation, portal connection, physical crossing, planar displacement, tether and mandatory ending.
Treat every planar-tagged effect as teleportation or reuse one global block/return rule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend per-operation source classifications, ordinary paid/counter timing and atomic body/custody handling. Specify known preflight versus hidden paid failure without giving a hidden-state diagnostic. Banishment terminal exceptions are not automatically inherited.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original realm prose includes unusual time and the owner defines primordial Cycle as an age; neither supplies a gameplay clock conversion. Opening/Horn/Hunt and independent source deadlines already exist.
options: Keep actual elapsed deadlines and existing source clocks; label any different spell-local clock as a separately reviewed exception.
Infer stasis, rest refresh, Hunt avoidance or time acceleration from realm lore.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend unchanged real clocks and source-specific resource/rest permissions. Preserve geography bypass where an actual route allows it, while not automatically completing Extraction or changing Hunt/death/cargo records.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both actual rank8 placements promise creation of a private extradimensional space/room; actual class grants remain Conjuration. No room dimensions, boundary material or entry geometry are printed.
options: Author a bounded persistent room with explicit dimensions, support, environmental behavior and one actual access interface.
Make only a temporary Banishment-sized cell or silently import another game’s Demiplane.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain a useful actual private room. GPT must select explicit NEW dimensions/capacity and entry geometry, including all-body fit and mandatory anatomy changes. Ephemeral boundaries must not become free saleable raw materials; supplies and furniture retain actual sources.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core120ft/Instantaneous describes creation but gives no door duration, directionality, admission credential, remote view or later re-entry.
options: Separate persistent room identity from a finite connection; define full local/remote entry predicates and later reopening.
Treat privacy as absolute invulnerability or grant arbitrary remote entry into any named space.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit NEW entrance duration, actual movement cost, one/two-way choice, permitted users and reopening by the actual room’s retained identity. Publicly seeing a doorway is not necessarily owning its key. No secret-plane location oracle, unprinted attack passage or automatic remote line of effect.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Create a room does not specify one room per caster, replacement of older rooms, abandoned rooms or what happens to stored living creatures and cargo.
options: Choose a finite active-space ownership rule while preserving exact occupants, objects and lawful transfers; never overwrite a nonempty room.
Silently delete an older room and its contents on recast/death or duplicate stored inventories.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a bounded explicit room/connection registry with stable IDs, actual ownership and deterministic handling of old rooms on recast, death and save/load. Resolve persistent useful storage without making repeated casts unlimited free physical stock. Different casters cannot inherit access by name alone.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Banishment closes on suppression with a scoped terminal-return exception; Faction Portal instead suppresses access until its original deadline. Neither defines Demiplane.
options: Choose separate suppression/dispelling behavior for room and connection, with deterministic settlement of every extant identity.
Borrow whichever earlier ending avoids a hard case without an explicit scoped extension.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend expressly decide whether inaccessible rooms persist and what true room removal does. A closing door never bisects transit. Define actual origins/anchors for visitors born, summoned or transferred inside; no unseen deletion, arbitrary tactical relocation or indefinite imprisonment caused only by a failed placement operation.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A private extradimensional room does not establish its native inhabitants, souls, safe-rest immunity, relation to the Heartcell or website rings.
options: Use a newly generated spell-space only with bounded privacy and real ongoing creature/effect records.
Assign canonical plane, divine sanctuary, afterlife, protected rest or new native population from its name.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend generated opaque plane/space references and explicitly limited ordinary information/travel interfaces. Any actual escape, summons, rest or resource refill requires its own source. Keep original cosmology open and preserve campaign disclosure boundaries.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both Illusion8 and Universal8 say trap a creature in an extradimensional labyrinth. Core gives no save or concentration and prints Instantaneous. This is not Mind Maze’s subjective display.
options: Author a genuine extradimensional captivity application with explicit initial resistance, hard-control admission and duration.
Reduce the spell to an observer-private illusion or import an unstated external Maze rule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain real labyrinth displacement and actual agency, preserving both placements and current class-school access. GPT must select NEW save/automatic admission choice, concentration and finite maximum; encounter-removal uses the accepted hard-control gate only where explicitly applicable.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The labyrinth promise requires a real navigable challenge, but no topology, dimensions, exit condition, INT check or automatic species escape is printed.
options: Define deterministic generated topology/seed and a finite ordinary navigation/escape procedure, including small and large bodies.
Use an abstract roll that makes the labyrinth irrelevant or silently give named creatures automatic escape.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend an executable finite labyrinth with explicit passages, whole-body fit, movement and escape interaction; any check costs, DC, cadence or species privilege are NEW. No regeneration may invalidate visited routes without a stated rule. Preserve meaningful choices and actual action costs.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No printed rule describes freedom, source suppression, concentration loss, death, corpses, later visitors or expiry inside Maze.
options: Specify a complete closure/escape lifecycle and real body/object placement with bounded source-specific exceptions.
Leave permanent sealed survivors or reuse Banishment’s exceptions without review.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend define terminal return/anchor and settlement for every genuine occupant and object, preserving escaped identities, deaths, source expiry and carried creatures. A source ending never duplicates lost gear or revives a dead target; physical conflict cannot silently extend the effect.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual Dimensional Door is same-plane only; Faction Portal may reach a qualifying real headquarters on another plane; accepted True Seeing distinguishes subjective mental effects from physical geometry.
options: Apply each actual escape, information and suppression source by its exact predicate; a real maze remains physically real.
Let True Seeing universally dispel it or assume every teleport escapes it.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit access/knowledge/range/plane/body checks. Keep Maze distinct from accepted Mind Maze and Mental Prison. A named school does not make real walls false or grant immunity. Resolve suppression of target, connection and source separately.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source does not specify recasting on an absent target, independent prisoners, shared labyrinths or concurrent caster ownership.
options: Choose one bounded application/space policy with actual perceived targets and original clocks.
Allow hidden absent-target selection, unlimited nested realms or recast-based imprisonment refresh.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend stable per-application identity, explicit replacement/nesting handling and no free target knowledge. Disclose whether separate captives ever share space and how visitors create closure metadata; decide without revising canonical realm identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Close ALL connections to a SPECIFIC plane WITHIN1mile; Core range120ft and Instantaneous. No boundary shape or center rule is supplied.
options: Select one actual plane identity plus a fixed local one-mile region, explicitly reconciling120ft placement range.
Treat one mile as target range, silently reduce ALL to one portal, or close all planes.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend NEW fixed spherical area centered on a legally placed point within120ft, with whole-connection endpoint predicates stated. Include inaccessible/hidden connections without granting a locator. An undefined plane name fails designation without inventing identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual portals, Planar Window, exile cells and long-term compulsion have distinct crossing/information/source relationships. Close connections does not define what counts.
options: Define an exact connection taxonomy and apply ALL qualifying connections to the selected plane; distinguish existing effects from ongoing links.
End every spell involving a planar creature or classify only visible doorways.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend decide real transit apertures, scrying windows, telepathy or persistent summon tethers individually from actual sources. Do not unsummon a body merely because it previously arrived, sever a soul, erase an existing plane or promote every sustained effect into a connection.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The verb close and Instantaneous can mean a one-time closure; a continuing prohibition against new connections would be new power.
options: One-time atomic closure of qualifying existing connections; later independent opening remains possible.
A separately authored continuing seal with explicit duration, concentration and reopening limits.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend one-time closure unless joint review chooses and labels a finite ongoing ward. Preserve the full one-mile/all-connections benefit. Do not accidentally turn instantaneous closure into permanent global prevention or silently pause independent clocks.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Closing during a genuine transit or exile ending can strand, split or delete bodies unless ordering is explicit; ordinary Ready resolves after its completed trigger.
options: Finish committed atomic crossings, then close later use; explicitly adjudicate true interruption sources and mandatory endings.
Bisect a body or convert ordinary Ready into a mid-transit interrupt.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend deterministic event order, source-specific terminal settlement and exact metadata retention. Decide whether a terminal Banishment return is a sealable connection or a scoped mandatory transition; do not imply the spell inherits or overrides its exception silently.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Banish up to3 extraplanar creatures with CHA resistance. Planar Binding uses explicit source/current travel provenance, while Planar Barrier uses explicit extraplanar or established native relationship; these predicates are separately scoped.
options: Explicitly select a source-local extraplanar predicate and preserve missing/hidden qualification behavior.
Treat outsider, summoned, Elemental, Fiend, native and extraplanar as interchangeable.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain all three target opportunities and independent CHA saves, with an expressly selected predicate supported by actual body/source/plane records. Unknown native identity is not a discovered fact. Do not globally unify already accepted distinct predicates.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No temporary/native/home destination, duration, concentration or return rule accompanies the printed banishment. Ordinary Banishment uses a generated temporary cell; Banish Elemental adopts that only through an explicit extension.
options: Explicitly extend the bounded exile-cell contract with a selected duration and three independent records.
Send to a proved actual origin destination using a new complete return/placement contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend the narrow explicit cell extension if it preserves intended banishment without naming unproved native planes; retain Core Instantaneous as original evidence and disclose NEW continuing lifecycle. If a true origin-return interpretation is chosen, require actual provenance, safe deterministic placement and explicit failure behavior rather than inferred lore.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Up to3 selected extraplanar creatures can differ in saves, eligibility, defenses, carried bodies, hard-control history and destination validity.
options: Resolve independent named targets in stable order after one paid cast, preserving each lawful successful/failed result.
Abort/refund all results whenever one target is unknown or silently substitute another hidden eligible target.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit shared versus per-target application ownership, hard-control admissions, independent closure and suppression. No retargeting on a hidden failure, bundled creature-as-cargo trick, inventory duplication or new target fact disclosure.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Rulebook/catalog says permanently bound to the Veiled Expanse unless freed; retained Core says Shadowfell. Original Cosmology describes Veiled Expanse; current bounded plane review forbids identity merges from theme.
options: Use Veiled Expanse as the spell’s explicit authored destination label while preserving the Core conflict; do not equate realms globally.
Hold destination-dependent outcomes until the owner settles the specific naming conflict.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend source-first joint disposition before authored destination use. If the first option is selected, it is only this spell’s source reconciliation, not proof Shadowfell is Veiled Expanse or a new cosmology map. No wider realm merger is authorized.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Permanently bound to a plane unless freed, with Until Dispelled, does not define whether the body moves there immediately, only becomes unable to leave, or gains a remote tether.
options: Choose explicit planar relocation plus a persistent escape restriction with full arrival rules.
Choose a binding record whose first lawful arrival establishes confinement, with disclosed current-world effect.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require joint selection of the intended full benefit, initial resistance/hard admission, body eligibility and exact release condition. Do not replace permanent-until-freed with an arbitrary short timer or claim passive tethering achieves immediate banishment.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Until Dispelled/unless freed implies a genuine release route but names no freeing effect, suppression consequence, return destination or recasting policy.
options: Define eligible actual dispel/release predicates, suppression behavior and whether release returns the body or only lifts the restriction.
Make it impossible to free, allow any generic restoration automatically, or grant tactical destination choice without source.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend persistent same-identity binding until a real selected ending; explicitly distinguish source suppression from true dispel. Specify actual-caster death, replacement, travel blockers and remaining occupants/cargo without deleting the binding’s history or inventing a free round trip.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original Veiled Expanse imagery does not establish that every occupant is dead, native, soulless or already hunted. Owner Hunt exceptions are extremely rare Divine/Abyssal intervention, not routine planar magic.
options: Keep the actual living/dead body, source lifetime and independent Hunt/recovery rules; no soul relocation is inferred.
Treat exile as death, rewrite origin/soul identity, or create a repeatable Hunt escape.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend preserve all real HP/death/research/taint/source records and inventory provenance. Determine any legitimate ordinary-world survival needs from actual creature/realm content; do not invent a universal environmental hazard or sanctuary from evocative lore.

futureCaseRequirements: At least two full deterministic cases per spell after choices, with actual class access/resources/source actors/target predicates, RNG, geometry, clocks, object custody and exact final records.
Demiplane: create/reopen actual room, multiple bodies/items and lawful independent transfers; source/door suppression and closure during atomic crossing with nonempty old space.
Maze: real full-body labyrinth movement/escape, actual save/hard history and clocks; independent visitor/summon, death or mandatory anatomy change and finite closure/blocked placement.

Planar Seal: one-mile mixed connection graph to selected plane, hidden endpoints without locator, real concurrent crossing and unaffected other-plane connections; distinguish one-time closure from new future source creation.
Seal of Banishment: three separately eligible/resisting/unqualified bodies, each source-local predicate and hard history, legal custody, exact independent endings and no invented origin world.

Gloom Bind: resolved source-naming premise and genuine arrival/binding, persistent imprisonment and real freeing/suppression; actual corpse/body expiry, cargo and Hunt restrictions without automatic soul/history changes.
No source-only creature, undefined plane identity, invented travel provider or isolated reference model supplies runtime/semantic evidence beyond its disclosed inputs.

sourceFindings: Demiplane has two preserved placements but actual grants are Conjuration; private created room and useful persistence/access remain benefits to complete.
Maze is an actual extradimensional labyrinth in both preserved placements; Wizard uses Illusion, Cleric/Mage Universal. Do not reduce it to already accepted Mind Maze.
Planar Seal says ALL connections to ONE specific plane within1mile.120ft local placement versus area, connection categories and one-time closure versus ongoing prohibition need express decisions.
Seal of Banishment retains three extraplanar targets and separate CHA saves; native/home plane, outsiders, summon status and source-specific extraplanar predicates are not synonyms.
Gloom Bind preserves rulebook Veiled Expanse versus Core Shadowfell and permanent-unless-freed/Until Dispelled wording. No realm equivalence or arbitrary short duration is selected.

Owner update02 supersedes older unresolved source-preference/Cycle statements: original manuscripts first, explicit corrections next, Cycle is an age with no mortal-time conversion. Underlying builder, Choir chronology/mapping and realm identities remain open.

Banishment exact cell/closure/conflict/terminal exception, Planar Binding provenance, Planar Barrier native predicate, Faction Portal crossing and Planar Window information are separate scoped authorities.
Copied-feat review is active in Part5. Control15 is exactly accepted but unapplied; ordinary Ready target/release and cross-round copied Ready remain separately scoped proposed changes.
